subject: R3.3 problem with devtools::build_win? (curl::curl_fetch_memory(url, handle = h) :    Upload failed (at start/before it took off)

messages.author: 0dd6c9694b3c4809
messages.subject: R3.3 problem with devtools::build_win? (curl::curl_fetch_memory(url, handle = h) :    Upload failed (at start/before it took off)
parts:
Updated to R 3.3.0 and trying to build my package for windows check.

However, build_win is failing to send the binary:

devtools::build_win("~/bin/umx")
...
* building ‘umx_1.2.7.tar.gz’
Error in curl::curl_fetch_memory(url, handle = h) : 
  Upload failed (at start/before it took off)


Is that a known issue?

version  # R version 3.3.0 RC (2016-04-25 r70548)

packageVersion("devtools") # ‘1.11.1.9000’

packageVersion("curl")  #[1] ‘0.9.7’

I've seen that happen before if you've uploaded the package already,
and it's in the builder queue.
Hadley
